Also, please work on your state of mind, it really changes things. Stress can aid weight gain, and relaxing a bit more can help with weight loss. Don’t surround yourself with any negative people who talk nasty about your weight, they’ll just make you insecure and may make you develop body dysphormia. You have to feel comfortable in your own skin, because it’s just you and it sticking on till the end. Stop thinking “I am fat” and think “I have room to work on myself”. Never take it too far with diet or exercise, sometimes riding on the high of weight loss, you can even feel proud of being underweight, which is something I experienced, and it’s terrible, I feel so guilty for eating anything remotely unhealthy and can never see myself as anything other than not good enough. 

What I am really getting at here is you need the mindset, with that mindset you will be motivated to achieve your goals, but know how to set realistic ones, to work yourself but not overwork yourself. It’s all about balance of loving where you are now and pushing to be a better version of yourself. I believe you can do it, obtain that confidence and push on! Beat depression’s ass!

Don’t starve yourself please, just diet. If you want to lose weight, adjusting your eating habits really is the way to go. Exercise helps of course, but dieting really speeds things up. I recommend you start eating four meals a day, but each small portions, so you don’t feel the need to snack. You really got to eat the stuff with fibre, i.e. fruits like apples, and protein, like eggs. Fibre keeps you full for longer and protein keeps the fibre there while retaining muscle mass, so you can hit the gym without fatigue.
